metadata.title: BYD’s EV Sales Plunge in China. What It Means for Tesla<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
BYD’s EV Sales Plunge in China. What It Means for Tesla.
Sales at Chinese EV leader BYD dropped year over year, even as exports exploded. The Chinese car market isn’t healthy, and that pain is spreading elsewhere.
